headline: Step 3 · 1691 Boundary Act (Equation 4.2)

terms.gloss: Outlawed intermarriage with Black, mulatto, or Indigenous partners under banishment
Five years extra servitude for white mothers; thirty years indenture for mixed-race children
Enforced through 1924 Racial Integrity Act and Bazile (1965) until Loving v. Virginia (1967)

sources: Hening's Statutes at Large, Vol. 3 (1691); Loving v. Virginia, 388 U.S. 1 (1967); Ch. 4
